name: ctk
description: Token-light team companion: capped agent teams, risk-based review, disciplined debugging.

maxWorkers.title: Max live teammates
maxWorkers.description: Hard cap on teammates alive at once. Further spawns are refused.

explorerModel.title: Explorer model
explorerModel.description: Model for ctk:explorer: an alias, a full model id, or inherit.

implementerModel.title: Implementer model
implementerModel.description: Model for ctk:implementer: an alias, a full model id, or inherit.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Model for ctk:reviewer: an alias, a full model id, or inherit.

highRiskModel.title: High-risk reviewer model
highRiskModel.description: Model for ctk:high-risk-reviewer: an alias, a full model id, or inherit.

hudBand.title: Team band
hudBand.description: Show the one-line team status band above the prompt.

hudIdle.title: Band while no team runs
hudIdle.description: full, minimal (only the CTK entry and the guard) or hidden (use /ctk-mission). The band always shows once a teammate has started.

recordStats.title: Record stats
recordStats.description: Write small per-session counters for the ctk stats command.

teamHint.title: Team hint
teamHint.description: When your own prompt asks for several agents or a team, add one hidden hint line so Claude loads the CTK team skill. No model call. Turn off to disable.
